note: v2.3 plan 10 (A): 24 new windows over the same Adolion pool, 8 of them Spanish, written to compare Noul-sort against Score-sort on ORDER rather than on whether the right entries came back at all (the v2.2 pair, lore.json, already covers that). The windows were written before any answer was read, and their text avoids the needed entries' own keywords so keyword activation is not what decides.
labellingRule: An entry's level is decided by the window alone, before any answer is read: `needed` when the next reply cannot be written correctly without it, `useful` when it would ground the reply, `background` for general world information with nothing specific to the scene, `irrelevant` otherwise. Every entry the two arms rank in their top 5 is labelled, because those are the entries a ranking decision is made between; an entry neither arm retrieved keeps the v2.2 `needed` list as its only label.

scene.objective: Get the party through the caverns alive.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The tunnel opens into a grotto lit only by pale glowing caps on the rock, and further down the dark there are voices.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "The pale ones below. They keep slaves, and they think everything that walks in the sun is cattle. We go quietly or not at all."

scene.objective: Survive what is guarding the road.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Something steps out of the rocks into the road: seven feet of muscle, a bull's head on a man's shoulders, dragging a huge axe.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Nobody move. It hasn't seen us yet."

scene.objective: Find out what has been killing the shepherds.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: A carcass the size of a cart lies half-eaten in the sand, and the tracks around it are lion-wide and clawed like a lizard's.

window.speaker: Belle
window.text: "Venom in the tail marks, fire around the muzzle. That's not a beast, that's a border dispute."

scene.objective: Put the family to rest.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The woman who died here died badly, and the cold in the room has not lifted since. Something is still standing in the corner.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "We need a rite, not a sword. Cutting it does nothing while its business is unfinished."

scene.objective: Learn what is keeping the dead standing.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The vault is full of them: some still wearing flesh, most down to bare yellow bones, all of them holding rusted weapons and all of them facing the door.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Something in here is still giving the orders."

scene.objective: Work out who is buying the old books.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Half the shelves are gone. The only volumes anyone still wants are the ones about her - the one who almost emptied the world once, and the rites for bringing her back.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Whoever is collecting these isn't a scholar. They're a congregation."

scene.objective: Say nothing you will regret.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The man across the table has no shadow worth the name, walks out at noon into the light without flinching, and is not afraid of the cross on the wall.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You're older than the church says anything can be. And you're not the only one awake, are you? They still haven't found her."

scene.objective: Get the wagon to the next town.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The driver has pointed ears under a wide hat, a tail coiled on the seat, and a nose that twitches every time the horses do.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You can hear them before we can, so you're on watch tonight."

scene.objective: Find out who invited you.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The host's smile never reaches the eyes, every guest agrees with everything, and the wine has been poured by the same hand all evening without tiring.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "They aren't feeding on the food. Watch who keeps finding excuses to touch someone."

scene.objective: Get in without being burned out.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The riders wear red over their armour and carry brands as well as swords. They have already decided what everyone in the village is, and they are working through the houses one at a time.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "Whatever they're hunting, they don't need proof of it."

scene.objective: Ask the small shaman for passage.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The speaker is waist-high with a snout and scales, wearing more jewellery than the baron, and the rest of the little folk go quiet when it raises a claw.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You didn't get this patch of forest by being liked. What did it cost you to be allowed to speak for him?"

scene.objective: Decide whether to hire him.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: He pours the tea without being asked, knows where every door in the house leads, and offers his terms like a man who has been waiting a long time for the right offer.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You fight with your hands, and you've never lost. What are you actually asking for?"

scene.objective: Kill it before it charges.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The clearing stinks of scorched hair. It is the size of a man, its tusks are longer than a forearm, and embers leak from its snout when it breathes.

window.speaker: Belle
window.text: "Not the chest. The neck, before it turns."

scene.objective: Count them, then leave.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The camp fills the whole valley floor: thousands of cookfires, one banner, one chief, and no quarrelling between tents.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "No tribe holds together at this size without someone who can hold it. Which one is his?"

scene.objective: Learn the layout of the capital before dark.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The streets are wide with stalls on both sides, then a wall, then the part where the doors are gilded and the guards count you as you pass, and past that the bells of the sacred quarter.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Markets, mansions, temples. If she's a hostage she's in the second, and if she's an offering she's in the third."

scene.objective: Win a wager without making an enemy.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The small archer in the green cloak puts four shafts inside a palm's width at sixty paces and glares at anyone who smiles.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "I'm not going to say it. I want to keep my fingers."

scene.objective: Averiguar quién paga las misiones del este.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: La chica del pelo corto en dos moños lleva el registro de todo el mundo y no mira a nadie dos veces; el resto de la sala sí.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "¿Y tú qué ganas con saberlo todo? A mí me sirve cualquiera que recuerde las caras."

scene.objective: Elegir a quién se le puede preguntar sin llamar la atención.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "No preguntes al primero que veas. Hay un herrero que lo sabe todo de esta comarca y una mujer noble que paga por enterarse la primera."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "¿Nombres? Necesito nombres de gente que hable."

scene.objective: Decidir si cruzar.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: El guardia señala el mapa con dos dedos. "Ahí no. El gremio lo cerró hace años y a quien vuelve no se le paga nada."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "¿Y qué hay dentro que dé tanto miedo como para prohibirlo en vez de limpiarlo?"

scene.objective: Conseguir el permiso de paso.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: El trono está al este de todo, en la parte del continente que está en paz con los que no deberían ser sus aliados.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "¿Su majestad sabe que su pacto con ellos se leería mal en las parroquias?"

scene.objective: Salir con algo que pagar.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: Cuelgan las tareas por letras. Las de la parte baja del alfabeto no las quiere nadie; las de arriba llevan sello de cera y nadie se ofrece.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Empecemos por abajo. Todo el mundo sube la escalera desde el primer escalón."

scene.objective: Aguantar hasta que amanezca.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: Lo que empuja desde fuera no tiene una forma fija: a veces manos, a veces alas, siempre con demasiados ojos.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "No vienen de este mundo. La sal los aguanta, pero no los hiere."

scene.objective: Encontrar a la mujer que cura por un precio raro.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: En las aldea de los alrededores la llaman de todo: bruja, santa, estafadora. Todas las versiones coinciden en que cobra distinto a cada uno.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Y en que a nadie le ha ido peor después. Eso ya es más de lo que puede decir el templo."

scene.objective: Work out how many are out there and who is leading them.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The big one left a club's worth of damage and a trail you could follow blind. The little ones did the searching, and they did it in order, room by room.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "The brute is the muscle. Somebody smaller and smarter is running this."

scene.objective: Averiguar de dónde salen los modelos.

window.speaker: Narrador
window.text: Los cuadros cuelgan en fila y todos son el mismo instante: alguien a punto de dejar de estar. Los compradores ricos pagan por mirarlos.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Los rostros no están inventados. Son personas que existieron, y ninguna figura en las listas de vecinos."
